senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָרַר I)to break through, dig; to search, seek.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 9</cite> <he>ששוקדים ושׁוֹחֲרִים וכ׳</he> they watch, and search, and investigate &c.

senses.gloss: to pass through a cavity or a groove.
units: ib. V, 1 ומאן דתני מַשְׁחִירִין וכ׳ nor is he wrong who reads mashḥirin (in place of משילין, referring for evidence to השחור, v. שָׁחוֹר II).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:8">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>שִׁחַרְתִּיךָ לי</he>, v. <cite ref="T00520"><he>רֶחֶם</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 869:3">Yalk. Ps. 869</cite>.
